title: GCP Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for GCP Data Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub

Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL

Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)

Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization

GCP certifications

Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP

Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)

Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures

Understanding of Data Lake layers

Knowledge of batch and streaming processing

Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and NoSQL)

Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.

Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.

Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.

Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.

Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.

Implement best practices for DataOps and Data Governance.


BigQuery, Dataflow, AlloyDB, APIGee (focus in GCP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

O profissional será responsável por transformar dados complexos em informações estratégicas. Construir pipelines robustos e escaláveis, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança das informações. E gerar insights que apoiarão a tomada de decisões em várias áreas da empresa, incluindo finanças, clientes e software.


Escopo e responsabilidades

  • Construção de Pipelines (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver e monitorar pipelines escaláveis utilizando Python e ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Suporte ao BI e Analytics: Estruturar visões no Metabase para consultas rápidas e gerenciar a exploração de dados complexos via Looker.
  • Otimização de Performance: Escrever queries SQL avançadas e otimizar o consumo de dados das ferramentas de visualização para reduzir custos e tempo de resposta.
  • Qualidade de Dados: Implementar testes e monitoramento para garantir que as métricas no Looker e Metabase estejam sempre íntegras.



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Python: Experiência em automação, integração de APIs e bibliotecas de manipulação de dados.
  • SQL Avançado: Domínio absoluto de SQL para transformações complexas e otimização de bancos analíticos.
  • Looker: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de modelos, dimensões, medidas e gerenciamento de projetos dentro do Looker.
  • Metabase: Capacidade de configurar dashboards e perguntas via interface e SQL.
  • Pipelines de Dados: Vivência com orquestradores (Airflow, dbt ou similares).
  • Cloud Data Warehouse: Conhecimento em BigQuery.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora

title: Gerente Distrital de Vendas
description:
Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia;
  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).


Informações adicionais:


Benefícios:


  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR


Buscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!


SOMOS LEGRAND


Há mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Desenvolvedor JAVA Sênior
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Código da oportunidade: 56985

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java, Springboot, mensageria, conceitos de devops, esteira CI/CD, terraform e AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Sênior para atuar na manutenção, evolução e desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos, participando ativamente das definições de arquitetura e dos processos de desenvolvimento. O(a) profissional irá trabalhar em ambientes complexos, com forte integração entre sistemas, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software e metodologias ágeis.


Responsabilidades


  • Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva, além da codificação de sistemas.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e definições de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar no uso de metodologias de desenvolvimento de sistemas e na especificação funcional.
  • Realizar modelagem e mapeamento de processos.
  • Conduzir levantamentos de dados complementares (negócios, integrações e técnicos).
  • Desenvolver e executar testes unitários e integrados.
  • Criar e manter Queries, Stored Procedures, Triggers, Functions e Views.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do SCRUM (planning, dailies, reviews e retrospectives).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com Java 1.8 ou superior, incluindo:
  • EJB, Servlet, JDBC, Swing e WebServices.
  • Experiência com frameworks:
  • Hibernate, Spring, Struts, Aspose, Jasper, Oracle Toplink e Quartz.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL (Microsoft SSIS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados:
  • SQL Server, DB2 e Oracle.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com UML.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento:
  • Eclipse, Maven, Ant e SVN.
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.



Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com .NET.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle PL/SQL.
  • Vivência com WebSphere.
  • Conhecimentos ou práticas em DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Cursos técnicos ou de especialização na área.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento no segmento de seguros.
  • Certificações técnicas.
  • Conhecimento em Espanhol.

title: Desenvolvedor Back-End - .Net
description:
Código da vaga:57319


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

O profissional irá atuar com Angular no App, passando por todo ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de requisitos até a implantação dos projetos, apoiando na construção de produtos.


Responsabilidades:

Experiência Desenvolvedor .net com experiência em ambientes escaláveis, microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria.


Responsabilidades:

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ e outras soluções de mensageria;

Monitorar e escalar sistemas distribuídos de alta performance;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB);


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Experiência prática com AWS e suas principais ferramentas;

Conhecimento em RabbitMQ;

Domínio de arquitetura de microsserviços;

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL);

Experiência com MongoDB;

Capacidade de trabalhar com times ágeis, CI/CD e versionamento com Git.

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Responsabilidades:

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ e outras soluções de mensageria;

Experiência prática com AWS e suas principais ferramentas;

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Game Customer Service Contractor（Part-Time）
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Handle escalated tickets from Level 1 CS contractors, primarily responsible for processing non-in-game currency or score editting escalated tickets. To review game knowledge from product development documentation on confluence, internal knowledge database, GM backend tool queries, and direct communication with dev team to provide clear response instructions to Level 1 CS contractors based on SOPs until the issue is resolved. The quantity and quality of escalated tickets processed will impact contract renewal, with a benchmark requirement of 30 escalated tickets per 4-hour shift.

2. Summarize player inquiries on daily/weekly/monthly basis, identify and alert potential game bugs/SOP flaws/inadequate knowledge database content, etc., and report to the customer service supervisor for further optimizatio.n

3. Conduct quality sampling checks on Level 1 CS contractors replies, compile QC reports, and follow up on feedback and guidance for Level 1 CS contractors' quality performance.


Job Requirements:

1. Willing to work as non-direct employee with up to 4-hour a day, with compensation based on attendance hours.

2. Familiar with CRM tools such as Aihelp/Helpshift, and have a basic understanding of casual games or card games.

3. English B2 level or above. Native in Spanish or Portuguese or command of Chinese is a plus, as the role requires understanding customer service backend tools that may include Chinese.

4. Prior experience in direct user-facing (to C) service roles handling customer issues (

Customer Support Professional with L2 experience in:

  • Online gaming platforms
  • Cloud service solutions
  • Internet-based products)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Business Analyst Quality Assurance
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider merging innovation, expertise, and strategic insight. With headquarters in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India, MillionLogics is dedicated to delivering scalable, future-ready solutions. Specialising in Data & AI, Cloud solutions, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics empowers organisations to evolve and drive digital transformation. Backed by over 40+ technology experts, the company ensures tailored, results-driven solutions for clients worldwide. For more details, visit: MillionLogics Services.


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Experience : 1+ years of experience

Compensation : USD 1500 per month (net/take-home)

Joining: Immediate

Mode of Work : FULLY REMOTE

Number of positions : 75

Selection Criteria : Offline Assessment (No interview is required)


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.
  • Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30-40 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.
  • Duration: 18 months


How to apply? Please send us your updated cv to with JOB ID: 59315 as your email subject.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.


Estamos a procura de Projetistas de Produto Pleno e Sênior.


Áreas:

  • Body in White;
  • Closures;
  • Internal Trims;
  • External Trims;


Formação:

  • Engenharia mecânica, Mecatrônica ou Produção.
  • Técnico em Mecânica ou Mecatrônica.


Requisitos:

  • 5 anos ou mais de experiência como projetista de desenvolvimento de produto nas áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de peças plásticas;
  • Conhecimento e domínio dos softwares CATIA V5 ou Unigraphics NX (testes poderão ser aplicados durante o processo);
  • Oportunidades para desenvolvimento de atividades de forma remota / híbrida e presencial.
  • Desejável: Inglês Avançado (Não Mandatório);

title: Observability Engineer – PL/SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Observability Engineer – PL/SR para atuar no desenho, implementação e operação de soluções de observabilidade, garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta dos ambientes, aplicações e serviços em arquiteturas híbridas e multicloud.

Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e manter pipelines de telemetria para logs, métricas e traces ;
  • Desenvolver e operar a infraestrutura responsável pela coleta, processamento e roteamento de dados de observabilidade;
  • Arquitetar, implementar e operar a plataforma de observabilidade baseada no Grafana Stack ;
  • Integrar soluções de observabilidade em ambientes híbridos e multicloud , suportando diferentes tipos de workloads;
  • Trabalhar com ambientes containerizados e orquestrados com Kubernetes ;
  • Integrar observabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps ;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de plataforma, SRE e desenvolvimento para evolução contínua das soluções.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência com Grafana Stack (arquitetura, implementação e operação);
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de observabilidade (Logs, Metrics e Traces);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) e GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota o fuso horário de Portugal


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenTelemetry;
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em SRE ou engenharia de confiabilidade.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Back-end
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Java para atuar em um ambiente de alta criticidade , com foco em integrações, mensageria e microsserviços , participando ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Stack Tecnológico

Obrigatório:

  • Java 11+;
  • Spring Boot;
  • APIs REST;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • MongoDB;
  • Oracle.

Desejável:

  • Kafka;
  • Redis;
  • Docker;
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift;
  • Observabilidade (Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e consumir filas RabbitMQ (listeners para eventos de renovação e cancelamento).
  • Implementar integrações REST com sistemas como BCP, Bureau, Dossiê, Sinistro e Vistoria Prévia.
  • Desenvolver endpoints para geração de ofertas APA / AFI.
  • Realizar manutenção e ajustes em tabelas Oracle.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Participar de code reviews e pair programming.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços e APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais (Oracle/PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Versionamento de código com Git / GitLab.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes / OpenShift.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Certificação Oracle Certified Professional.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Mainframe Operations/Storage Engineer (IBM zOS)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Application Support- Dynatrace (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst

Duration: 6 months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

Cohesity is seeking a Senior Salesforce Business Analyst to join our fast-growing Go-to Market Systems team. This person will be a high-level strategic contributor that understands and documents the internal customer’s business requirements. You will work with internal developers and create functional specifications that meet those requirements and test the developed functionality. As the primary business systems liaison to the Channel sales team, you will be responsible for designing, managing, and improving our Salesforce Community. Direct experience solutioning for Salesforce Communities. You will lead discovery and analysis sessions with stakeholders and help business teams derive unambiguous business rules and requirements that can be translated into actionable specifications for development teams.

  • Responsible for business requirement understanding, Writing JIRA User Stories, Sprint planning, backlog grooming, and working with the development team for planning and solutioning.
  • Work closely with other teams to understand current and future requirements; suggest solutions and alternatives - transform business processes through technology. This person will be hands-on and will need to be an expert in the Salesforce Community platform.
  • Facilitate design, implementation, maintenance and enhancement of the SFDC Community application as well as other declarative parts of the Salesforce platform.
  • Develop and configure Salesforce Gainsight solutions, including customer health scoring, success plans, journey orchestration, lifecycle management, and reporting to enable proactive customer success initiatives.
  • Implement AI-driven automation and intelligence using Salesforce Einstein, predictive case routing, sentiment analysis, intelligent recommendations, and automated workflows to improve service efficiency and customer experience.
  • Partner with business domain leaders to create a robust Enterprise Application roadmap. Ensure this roadmap is well understood throughout the business functions and meet emerging requirements. Take the abstract of this roadmap down to threads of executional framework.
  • Collaborate with other Business Systems Analyst and Product Managers in both the US and offshore locations to drive the work
  • Support existing Partner community solutions (and related applications), working on production support, trouble-shooting issues, and implementing small to large enhancements.
  • Deliver Salesforce platform updates as a key member responsible for the design, development and release of strategic projects.
  • Specify implementation of standards, methods, and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and reliability of applications and software
  • Ensure Application Development initiatives and projects are well managed and deliver on expectations - functionality, timeliness, and cost
  • Able to foster a culture of transparency and a sense of purpose among the team, and create clear accountabilities and metrics


Professional Experience/Qualifications:

  • Has successfully led development and delivery of multiple complex business technology solutions into production that have achieved or surpassed business goals.
  • Experience developing and supporting mission critical applications optimized to run in the cloud or virtualized environments.
  • Deep knowledge of system architecture, technical design, and system and software
  • development technology.


Required Skills / Experiences:

  • 6+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Computer Engineering or equivalent technical degree
  • 3+ years of experience as a business analyst/product manager supporting Salesforce Community platform.
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce.com product suite including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, FSL, Community Cloud, and the AppExchange.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Gainsight, including configuration, data modeling, rules engine, success plans, and reporting (or strong experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce).
  • Knowledge of Customer Success metrics (Health Score, NPS, CSAT, Renewal Risk)
  • Experience implementing AI-powered automation within Salesforce using Einstein AI, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows.
  • Experience with Einstein Bots, Digital Engagement, and AI-driven service analytics
  • Managing application development at scale, employing SDLC methodologies including Agile, Scrum, and DevOps
  • Skilled at setting and communicating priorities effectively; able to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Exceptional ability to lead change using positive and collaborative methods
  • Strong communication skills in writing, speaking, and presenting
  • Able to communicate technical or complex subject matter in business terms
  • Accepts ownership and welcomes responsibility

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.
